VAL-SKEL-009.description: Live refresh — single SSE subscription, debounced re-fetch
criteria: A single SSE subscription to /api/events is active at any time
Any SSE event (heartbeat, agent.chat, connected) triggers a debounced re-fetch of the agent inventory
Rapid events are coalesced (debounced) into a single re-fetch
Stop() closes the connection and cleans up goroutines
No duplicate subscriptions when integrated into RunCockpit

architecture.deps_injection: config struct with injected APIClient, AgentAdapter, CockpitScreen
architecture.concurrency_model: single writer goroutine + mutex for started flag

sse_subscription.reconnect_on_drop: verified - run() loop reconnects after ReconnectDelay

debouncing.rapid_event_coalescing: verified - TestEventsSubscriber_DebouncedRefetch sends 5 events, expects 1 fetch
debouncing.timer_cleanup: debounceTimer.Stop() called in ParseConsoleEventStream return path

re_fetch.trigger: any SSE event (heartbeat, agent.chat, connected, etc.)
re_fetch.screen_optional: verified - TestEventsSubscriber_FetchesWithoutScreen tests nil Screen path

discovered_issues.description: The daemon does not currently emit SSE events on agent spawn/kill lifecycle changes. The EventsSubscriber compensates by re-fetching on ANY SSE event (heartbeat, agent.chat, connected) with debouncing. This is intentional — any SSE event from the daemon is sufficient to trigger a re-fetch, and heartbeat provides periodic refresh. This is documented in the integration test file and the implementation comment in RunCockpit.

summary: Implementation fully satisfies VAL-SKEL-009 requirements. Single SSE subscription with debounced re-fetch works correctly. All 15 tests pass under race detector. 0 lint issues. Goroutine leak check uses delta ≤ 2 approach (valid per skill guidelines). Pre-existing behavior note: daemon does not emit invalidate events on agent spawn/kill — EventsSubscriber compensates by re-fetching on ANY SSE event with debouncing.
